source_execution: Host reference only; no vendor source is linked into the gate.

boot0.license: Vendor-distributed opaque boot0; existing dependency record applies.

captured_rom.source: Recorded board ROM capture, rom-copy-20261016-084055; no source published.
captured_rom.sd_length_check: 0xae58..0xae78 calls 0x27e8; aligned 512 bytes and at most 0xa7800

rtc_manual.section: 4.2.4 PRCM inventory; 8.3.6.2 watchdog IRQ; 9.1.6 RTC inventory; 9.1.7.14 general-purpose registers; 9.1.7.16 reset status; 9.1.7.21 POR control
rtc_manual.condition: Retained while VDD_RTC > 0.7 V; power-removal retention is not established.

reset_cause.status: No retained A733 power-on-versus-warm reset cause is established by the inspected sources.
reset_cause.policy: Only confirmed cold power-on or an explicit one-use OS card-reboot request may permit card boot; without that request, warm, watchdog and unknown resets must select FEL.
reset_cause.implementation: Installation work remains blocked on the reset-cause predicate; the request-only RAM proof does not implement it.

excluded_indications.0x07090160 bit 13: Current reset assertion level, not preceding cause; manual 9.1.7.16.
excluded_indications.0x070901f4 bit 3: POR reset output enable, not cause; manual 9.1.7.21.
excluded_indications.0x02050004 bit 0: Interval interrupt pending, write-one-to-clear; retention across reset is unspecified; manual 8.3.6.2.
excluded_indications.0x07090304: ROM software progress; captured-ROM offsets 0x7c..0xc4 and helper 0xd14.
excluded_indications.AXP8191 0x50 bits 0..2: U-Boot pmu_axp8191.c:544..570 decodes supply-rise, button and IRQ power sources; no established SoC warm/watchdog distinction or reset/clear semantics.

limits: The ROM does not consume the RTC request; boot0 or the early gate does.
Direct ROM entry still checks the second redirect word.
The RAM proof establishes no storage loading or system-watchdog-reset-to-card recovery.
